title: Maternal Exposure to Air Pollution During Early Pregnancy and Congenital Heart Disease: An Exploratory Case-Control Analysis from Delhi NCR.
authors: Kukshal P, Sharma M, R B, Ahamad S, Singh P.
quote: VSD was consistently associated with PM 10 preconception [AOR = 3.13 (1.80-5.47)], poor AQI at conception [AOR = 3.18 (1.82-5.53)], and both poor AQI [AOR = 4.01 (2.28-7.08)] and PM 10 [AOR = 4.35 (2.41-7.83)] post-conception.
